title: Curtis Samuel 2023 Donruss Washington Commanders #294
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a Curtis Samuel 2023 Donruss Washington Commanders #294 trading card. It features the player in his football gear and is a part of the base set. The card is an original and not a licensed reprint, manufactured by Donruss. It is a National Football League (NFL) card with English language and is not autographed.

The card size is 3½" x 2½" and it is a parallel/variety base card. The card number is 294 and it is a part of the Washington Commanders team. It is a sports trading card for football enthusiasts and is not vintage. The card is a 2023 product and is categorized under Trading Card Singles, Sports Trading Cards, and Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop.
